page.layout: One block of running text on a single printed page. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. No marginal notes. Catchword at lower right.

p.i: de pœnitetia cogitent. Atq; ita consiliū Domini utrisq; bene cedit, necnon agendi recte occasione præbet. Respicit autem propheta simul ad ea quæ superiore capi-te de punitione impiorum & conseruatione piorum dicta sunt, simul ad illa quæ in antecedentibus vaticinijs de euertendis tot ciuitatibus hostium populi Dei, atq; etiā Babylonis tyrannidem in omnes exercetis crebrò inculcabantur: de Babylone quidè cap.17.21.de cæteris ciuitatibus nullo non capite. Obuenit aut hic observa-tio nona, neutiquā involuenda silentio, Quòd ex talibus in mundo mutationibus, & liberatione piorū, impiorumq; exterminio, Deus bonos pariter et malos cupiat occasione bene agendi arripere. Cæterum quia tyrannidë impiorum in pios coparauit inundationi atq; æstui, ideo attexit breuem earundem comparationum interpretatione, dicens: Spiritus frementium quasi inundatio murum deijciens, & velut æstus in loco arido: at nihilominus Deus fremitu & strepitum impiorum hostiū facile deijcit, facile procurat nubem, per quam æstus restinguatur, tandemq; universam tyrannorum propaginem tollit è medio. Sunt perquàm elegates si-militudines, quarum consideratio non exiguam in adversis consolationem adferre queat.

main_text.p: Et faciet Dominus.) Amplificatio beneficiorū Dei, in qua propheta quadā forma illationis, trāsit à liberatione è piculis corporeis et temporalibus, ad liberatione è piculis spiritualib. et æternis. Est enim sententia: Non

page.notes: Printed page 267, running head ANNOTATIONES. Text is set in italic, with the second paragraph in roman. The printed "Non" at lower right is the catchword, not running text. The text is clear throughout. Printed spellings are kept (elegates, coparauit, tyrannidë, cap.17.21); only u/v was normalised.
